paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi‑step agentic workflows, data pipelines and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment.

I have spent the past three years designing and operating agentic pipelines that integrate large language models with custom Python tooling and PostgreSQL back‑ends. By constructing CI workflows that trigger GitHub Actions on every code change, I have automated end‑to‑end testing and deployment of agentic services, guaranteeing that each new model version is validated against functional expectations before reaching production. My work routinely involved close collaboration with stakeholders to translate business requirements into reproducible CI pipelines, and I consistently monitored the health of those pipelines using the same observability principles I will bring to Valarian’s LLMOps stack. This experience directly satisfies the requirement for llm, agentic and GitHub Actions expertise, and it demonstrates my ability to deliver reliable, production‑grade AI infrastructure.

In a separate project I applied machine‑learning techniques to predict customer churn, employing XGBoost models tuned through systematic hyperparameter optimisation in R. The resulting propensity scores were integrated into a decision‑making workflow that evaluated risk in near‑real time, providing a clear evaluation metric for model performance across multiple release cycles. By iterating on feature engineering and leveraging rigorous evaluation practices, I ensured that each model iteration delivered measurable improvements in predictive accuracy. This background aligns with the evaluation and machine‑learning requirements of the role, and it equips me to build the monitoring and drift‑detection frameworks Valarian needs for its agentic AI platform.
